blocks.text: ‘s’ orbital ki shape spherical (gend jaisi gol) hai. s orbital mein nucleus ke gird electron density (electron milne ka imkaan) har taraf barabar phaili hoti hai. Principal quantum number barhne ke saath s orbital ka size bhi bara hota jata hai.

blocks.alt: x, y aur z mehwaron par do boundary surfaces, beech mein nucleus ka nuqta: (a) chhota gola, 1s, n = 1, l = 0, m = 0; (b) bara gola jis ke andar chhota gola hai, 2s, n = 2, l = 0, m = 0.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.5: (a) 1s aur (b) 2s ki boundary surface (kitab ki figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka; kitab mein doosri baar Figure 2.5 chhapa hai).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (a) 1s chhota gola hai aur (b) 2s bara gola, beech mein nucleus. Dono ke liye ℓ = 0 aur m = 0; farq sirf n ka hai (1 aur 2), is liye 2s bara hai.

blocks.prompt: 1s aur 2s orbitals ke quantum numbers likhein. Dono kis tarah ek jaise aur kis tarah alag hain?
blocks.explanation: 1s: n = 1, ℓ = 0, m = 0. 2s: n = 2, ℓ = 0, m = 0. Dono spherical hain aur density har taraf barabar hai; 2s bara hai aur us ki energy zyada hai.

items: s orbital spherical hai, density har taraf barabar; n barhe to s orbital bara (2s > 1s).
